justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,

Partner folders may contribute only two or three rows. These are context, not target sizes or performance promises.

The importer checklist says, “One folder scan produces one ordered stream of metadata rows.”

Keep the two remarks as separate concerns, not as formal acceptance criteria. The checklist sentence helps distinguish a batch boundary from a folder boundary. Do not infer any endpoint guarantee beyond the stated fact that it accepts lists.

## Boundaries and open question

No maximum list size has been documented for the downstream catalog. Treat the usual width as a configuration habit, not a documented endpoint limit. If logging is mentioned, state only that the folder name and scan timestamp are tracked elsewhere; do not specify a log schema or claim that group numbers are currently recorded.
